verdict.rationale: Hugging Face documents a public programmatic API. Inference Providers offers a single consistent API that is a drop-in replacement for OpenAI chat completions, with provider routing via model-id suffixes and billing via HTTP headers. The Hub has its own API docs page, and a probe confirmed a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /.well-known/openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of how much of the Hub's management operations the API covers (beyond inference calls).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: giving you access to their specialized capabilities through a single, consistent API
Drop-in replacement for the OpenAI chat completions API.
This can be done by passing `"X-HF-Bill-To: my-org-name"` as a header in your HTTP requests.
